title: claude-in-chrome computer tool: left_click_drag doesn't fire intermediate pointermove events
details:
**What happened:** Used `mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer` action `left_click_drag` to test a page's custom swipe-gesture handler (bound to `pointerdown`/`pointermove`/`pointerup`). The drag completed with no error, but the page's gesture logic never fired — the app state was unchanged after the drag.
**What the user said:** User didn't comment; observed by the model during self-verification of a feature before reporting it done.
**Repro:** Any page with a `pointermove`-driven drag/swipe handler (common pattern: track `dx`/`dy` across `pointermove` events to detect swipe direction). Call `left_click_drag` with a start/end coordinate on such an element. Confirmed via direct comparison: dispatching synthetic `PointerEvent('pointerdown'/'pointermove'×N/'pointerup')` via `javascript_tool` on the exact same element/coordinates worked correctly and advanced app state; `left_click_drag` alone did not.
**Cause:** `left_click_drag` appears to only dispatch the start and end pointer/mouse events (or dispatches events that don't synthesize `pointermove`), with no intermediate `pointermove` events — so handlers that compute drag distance/direction from a series of `pointermove` events never accumulate any movement.
**Evidence:** Session working directory `C:\Users\7make\Dev\Eng Shorts`, tested against `public/index.html`'s card swipe handler (`card.addEventListener('pointermove', ...)`).
